One branch of a hyperbola (shown above) is defined by the parametric equations

$$
x=4\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,y=5\operatorname{sec}⁡t.
$$

Determine the domain of the parameter $t$ for this branch, assuming that the entire hyperbola is defined only for $t\in [-\pi ,\pi ].$

$t\in (${{field-1}}$,$
{{field-2}}$)$
worked_solution:
The parametric equations of the full hyperbola are

$$
x=4\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,y=5\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,t\in [-\pi ,\pi ],\,t\ne \pm \frac{\pi }{2}.
$$

To restrict the parameterization to a single branch, we refer to the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14062908/assets/b8b14a6d9bf2f77c79b26172ec18e7833c1315ccb09c94be5a05b7e12714a14f.png)

We can see that if we restrict $t$ to $(-\frac{\pi }{2},\frac{\pi }{2}),$ we get only the upper branch.

Therefore, the parametric equations that describe only the upper branch are

$$
x=4\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,y=5\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,t\in (-\frac{\pi }{2},\frac{\pi }{2}).
$$
